payload.prompt: A slow, steady vertical tilt shot beginning at the base of a single lone, bare cedar tree standing in open snow, tilting slowly upward along the trunk to reveal several branches broken and splintered high above the ground. A single human figure in a heavy dark winter coat stands at the base looking up, back to camera the entire time, face never visible. Overcast winter light, muted desaturated cold color grading, quiet documentary/archival treatment. Full-bleed 9:16 vertical, no letterboxing, no black bars.
